# 📥 STEAMIDRA — DOWNLOAD PROBLEMS

Steam download failed? Try these **in order**.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 1️⃣ DDMod (Direct Download)
Download with **DDMod** instead → point it at a download folder → move the files into the game's install folder yourself.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 2️⃣ Grab an Older Version
Find the game on **[SteamDB](https://steamdb.info/)** → **Patches** tab → copy a **Build ID** → download that build in SteaMidra.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 🔑 Game Not Found? Add an API Key
If **Free Providers** (formerly *MidraEveryday*) can't find a game, get a free key from the **[Hubcap Manifests Discord](https://discord.gg/hubcapsmanifest)** and add it in **Settings** as a fallback provider.
-# The fork tests your keys at launch and warns you when one stops working.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## ⏸️ Game Keeps Auto-Updating?
On the fork, games stay on their pinned version by default. Change it per game in **Auto Update Games**.
